## Services

### Web Development
Professional websites and web applications built with React, Next.js, Vue.js, WordPress, and modern PHP frameworks. Responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and SEO optimization included.
- Starting price: €658 excl. VAT (€790 incl. 20% VAT for clients in Bulgaria)
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/sviluppo-siti-web/

### E-Commerce
Online stores with WooCommerce, Shopify, custom React + Stripe integrations. Multi-currency, multi-language, payment gateway integration.
- Starting price: €1,825 excl. VAT (€2,190 incl. 20% VAT for clients in Bulgaria)
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/ecommerce/

### Custom Software Development
Business automation tools, REST APIs, dashboards, internal systems. Built with Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker.
- Starting price: €2,000
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/sviluppo-software/

### Enterprise ERP Systems
Complete ERP solutions: accounting, warehouse, CRM, HR, BI, manufacturing modules. Used by Italian elevator manufacturers.
- Starting price: €5,000
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/erp/

### Mobile Applications
Native iOS and Android apps with React Native and Flutter. From design to App Store/Play Store deployment.
- Starting price: €3,000
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/app-mobile/

### SEO, GEO and AEO
Optimization for Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini. Local SEO for Italy and Bulgaria. Schema.org structured data, technical SEO.
- Starting price: €242/month excl. VAT (€290 incl. VAT in Bulgaria)
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/seo/

### Reverse Engineering & 3D Printing
Reverse engineering of mechanical parts and devices: scanning, CAD reconstruction, firmware and protocol analysis. 3D printing (FDM) of prototypes, unobtainable spare parts and small production batches.
- Pricing: per project, free quote within 24 hours

### Cloud Hosting
Managed VPS hosting on Hetzner with SSL, CDN, automated backups, 99.9% uptime SLA, monitoring.
- Starting price: €13/month excl. VAT (€15 incl. VAT in Bulgaria)
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/hosting/

## Pricing (2026, EUR — at least 15% below the average agency price)

Prices below are excluding VAT (Italian and English pages). The Bulgarian page shows the same packages including 20% VAT: Start €790, Business €1,890, Premium €4,290, Shop €2,190. Full price list with VAT rules, terms and market comparison: https://carbonstealth.eu/prezzi/ (EN: https://carbonstealth.eu/en/pricing/ · BG: https://carbonstealth.eu/bg/ceni/)

- **Start — landing page:** €658 (1 page, 1 language, EU hosting 12 months, SSL). Delivery 5–7 working days.
- **Business — company website:** €1,575 (up to 8 pages, 2 languages with hreflang, blog, full SEO/GEO/AEO). Delivery 10–15 working days. Most popular.
- **Premium — three languages + admin panel:** €3,575 (unlimited pages within scope, BG·EN·IT, admin panel, booking/catalogue module). Delivery 20–30 working days.
- **Shop — e-commerce:** €1,825 (catalogue, cart, Stripe + cash on delivery, invoices/VAT-OSS, 2 languages). Delivery 15–25 working days.
- **Add-ons (excl. VAT):** additional language €292 · additional page €100 · logo + mini brand book €325 · copywriting per page €75 · maintenance €58/month · SEO €242/month · EU hosting + SSL + CDN €13/month (after the first year).
- **VAT:** clients in Bulgaria pay the prices including 20% VAT (as shown on the Bulgarian page); EU companies outside Bulgaria are invoiced without VAT (reverse charge, Art. 196 Directive 2006/112/EC); companies outside the EU pay no Bulgarian VAT.
- **Not list packages:** ERP from €5,000, custom software from €2,000, mobile apps from €3,000 — fixed quote after analysis.
